description_en: Opens an existing whiteboard document and retrieves the connection information for the whiteboard document
description_zh: 打开已有白板文档，获取白板文档连接信息
name: OpenWhiteBoard

parameters.description_en: The unique identifier of the whiteboard application. To obtain the AppID, see [CreateApp](~~204234~~).
parameters.description_zh: 白板应用唯一标识符。获取AppID，请参见[CreateApp](~~204234~~)。
parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the whiteboard application. To obtain the AppID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204234.html
parameters.help_zh: 白板应用唯一标识符。获取AppID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204234.html
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.description_en: The ID of the user who opens the whiteboard (business user), consisting of 1 to 32 characters including uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens (-).
parameters.description_zh: 打开白板的用户ID（客户业务用户），由1~32位大小写字母、数字、下划线、短划线（-）组成。
parameters.help_en: The ID of the user who opens the whiteboard (business user), consisting of 1 to 32 characters including uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 打开白板的用户ID（客户业务用户），由1~32位大小写字母、数字、下划线、短划线（-）组成
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.description_en: The unique identifier of the whiteboard document. To obtain the DocKey, see [CreateWhiteBoard](~~204299~~).
parameters.description_zh: 白板文档唯一标识符。获取DocKey，请参见[CreateWhiteBoard](~~204299~~)。
parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the whiteboard document. To obtain the DocKey, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204299.html
parameters.help_zh: 白板文档唯一标识符。获取DocKey，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204299.html
parameters.name: doc_key
